name: OMHAS exploded puppet part sheet

canvas.background: transparent RGBA preferred; otherwise uniform #00FF00 without green in character

coordinates: Normalized sheet coordinates; boxes are [left, top, right, bottom], right/bottom exclusive. L/R are character anatomical left/right: front-facing L appears on viewer right.

slots.description: complete head including face, muzzle and back of skull; no ears or neck hole
both complete ears, separated by a transparent gap, bases at same height; no head pixels
complete torso and costume with neck, shoulder and hip overlap caps; no arms, legs, ears or backpack
anatomical left arm from rounded shoulder cap through complete hand/paw; neutral relaxed bend
anatomical right arm from rounded shoulder cap through complete hand/paw; neutral relaxed bend
anatomical left leg from rounded hip cap through complete foot/shoe
anatomical right leg from rounded hip cap through complete foot/shoe
complete backpack or supplied prop, with full hidden surfaces and straps; empty transparent cell if absent

acceptance: One part per cell except the paired ears; no touching adjacent cells
Common scale, orthographic front view, identical lighting and reference texture
No baked ground shadows, captions, labels, title, grid lines or registration marks
Paint hidden joint areas and overlap caps at least 32 pixels beyond the visible join
Do not synthesize a prop or ears if absent from the supplied reference
Manual visual review of every part and joint pivot before declaring ready
promptTemplate: Create a production puppet exploded part sheet for {character}, matching the attached character reference exactly: {description}. Output a 3072 x 3072 image with a strict invisible 3-column by 3-row grid, each cell 1024 x 1024 pixels. Transparent RGBA background; if transparency is unavailable use uniform pure #00FF00, with no green spill and no green in the character. Leave at least 96 pixels of clear margin inside every cell. Orthographic front view, same scale across every part, identical felt/fur/material texture, costume colors and soft neutral lighting. Do not resize parts individually to fill cells. In reading order place: row 1: head (without ears), ears (both complete ears with a gap), torso (costume included); row 2: arm_L, arm_R, leg_L; row 3: leg_R, prop_backpack, empty. L and R always mean the character's anatomical left and right; front-facing arm_L/leg_L belong on the viewer's right when assembled. Each arm includes its full shoulder, elbow, wrist and hand; each leg includes hip, knee, ankle and shoe. Reveal and paint all normally hidden surfaces, including complete rounded shoulder and hip caps and at least 32 pixels of joint overlap. Torso must be complete behind the removable limbs and backpack. Head includes the full skull and muzzle, ears include their full bases. Backpack/prop is fully separate with full hidden surfaces and straps; leave that cell empty if absent. For absent ears leave the ears cell empty. No duplicated anatomy, no detached fingers, no cropped extremities, no assembled character, no ground plane, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no title, no grid lines and no registration marks. Keep the final bottom-right cell empty. This sheet is for articulated animation, so preserve full silhouettes and hidden joint artwork rather than cutting holes where parts connect.
